question: What will be the ending value of the ICE BofA US High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread for these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: Latest FRED print is 3.44 (Oct 30), after a sharp widening from 2.60 in late August. Horizon is about 15 trading days to Nov 20. Status quo is roughly flat, with some mean reversion after spikes (the March 3.46 peak and the Oct 22 3.40 high both retraced) offset by momentum from news of a junk-market crack driven by AI issuance, rates and CCC stress. Unconditional median is about 3.40 with right skew. The 3.745 upper bound needs about +30bp, roughly a 1-SD widening, so P(above) is about 13%. The low bound is unreachable. No prediction market was found on Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold.

- Hedgeweek: credit hedge funds hit by a deepening global junk selloff. Bloomberg, Oct 2: global credit sputtering on jumbo deals.
- marketsfn, Oct 23: HY tightened 6bp to 327bp in a 'normal regime'. This shows two-way moves within October.
- Counter-evidence for reversion: spreads fell from the 3.46 peak in March to 2.83 by end of April; Oct 22 3.40 fell to 3.14 by Oct 28.
- Status quo: last value 3.44. Resolves off the FRED first-published value for Fri Nov 20, 2026, not later revisions.
- Event window: value as of Nov 20, 2026 close. As of Now (Nov 2), the last observation is Oct 30, so about 15 trading days remain.
- Dispersion: elevated-regime daily SD of about 7bp gives a 15-day SD of about 27bp.
- Searched for Kalshi, Polymarket and Manifold markets: none found. Could not find news dated after Oct 30 giving the Nov 2 level.

calls.reasoning: Last FRED print 3.44 (Oct 30) after a CCC-led widening from ~2.60 in late Aug. Single print on Nov 20, ~15 trading days out. Random walk from 3.44 with a mild mean-reversion tilt (prior spikes in Mar and late Oct retraced; Nov 2 equities +1%), offset by a fat right tail (CCC at 3-yr wides, hike risk, deleveraging). Unconditional median ~3.38; 14% above 3.745; percentiles are conditional on staying in range. No human prediction market found.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on every fact: last print 3.44 on 10/30, the October path, CCC wides, about 15 trading days to the single 11/20 print, and no market found. The disputes are judgment only: the size of the post-spike reversion (median 3.30-3.35) and the upper-escape mass (13-15%). The Nov 2 equity rally and retracements after past spikes support a slight tilt toward tightening. Realized October vol (~8bp/day) supports an SD of about 0.30 with a fat right tail. I take an unconditional median near 3.38, 14% above 3.745, and a conditional median of 3.32. I largely carry forward the runs' dispersion. I had no web access, so I retrieved no sources.

disagreements.verdict: 14%, given ~1 SD distance and fat right tail
